_comment: validate_uat.py config tailored to PM Agent (UAT Cycle 2 — post-19-fix commit). Targets the status_summary agent. healthScore is app-computed by computeHealthScore(), not a model output; spi/cpi are inputs echoed into metricsNarrative, not model-returned fields — those three have been removed from output_schema to match the actual prompt contract.

output_schema._comment: 8 fields the prompt actually asks the model to return. healthScore removed (app-computed). spi/cpi removed (inputs not outputs). ragRationale added as optional — model consistently returns it even though the prompt doesn't mandate it.

grounding._comment: Numbers are the yield here, not names. Every figure the narrative states must exist in the PM Q&A or the live EVM block passed into the prompt. This is the automated form of GR-3.

_placeholder_note: GR-3 legitimately instructs the model to emit [ASSUMPTION: ...] and <TBD - confirm with sponsor>. Those are compliant, not defects. The bare \bTBD\b pattern above will flag them - keep it, and disposition each hit: a marked assumption is a PASS, an unmarked TBD is a defect. If the noise becomes unmanageable, replace the TBD pattern with (?<!<)\bTBD\b(?! . confirm).

hedging_patterns._comment: Hedging in metricsNarrative usually marks an inference over data the PM never supplied. Route each hit to manual claim review rather than accepting it.

stability._comment: These five fields drive executive decisions. All must be byte-identical across repeated runs of the same input. Meaningless until temperature is pinned to 0 (DEF-001).
